name: token-weather-usage
description: One line above the prompt: context weather, tokens, a bar per recent prompt, then your 5-hour and 7-day limits against the time elapsed, with the reset time. Labels in English or French. After Token Weather (Anthropic, Apache-2.0) and the idea of usage-meter (HolyGrail).
